title: heare Phase A-hotfix-2 — Action output polish
notes: Triggered by live observation 2026-04-19 15:19-15:21: actions now complete (tool_result=1) but outputs are scrambled (topic JSON leaks into action summary), English, double-voiced, or mangled by the scrubber. Fix four concrete issues in one cycle. Keeps the SDK backend shared (no client split — that is Phase D) but serializes calls.

stories.title: Serialize SDK calls with an asyncio.Lock
stories.description: AgentSDKCLI currently lets ActionWorker and ConversationManager hit the single ClaudeSDKClient concurrently. Their streams interleave — topic-extraction JSON ends up in an action summary, 60s timeouts fire. Introduce an asyncio.Lock around _run_query so calls are serial. Cost: extract_topics waits for an in-flight action (acceptable — topic extraction is async background).
acceptanceCriteria: AgentSDKCLI gains a new _run_query_lock: asyncio.Lock attribute initialized in __init__.
_run_query acquires the lock around the entire call (rate_limit acquire + attempts). The lock is released on normal return and on exception.

A new test in tests/test_agent_sdk_cli.py spawns two concurrent call_decider tasks with distinct scripted responses and asserts each caller gets its OWN response (no mixing). Use asyncio.gather with staggered scripted responses.
Existing agent SDK tests still pass.

stories.title: Scrubber keeps 'Bash' in plain English
stories.description: Claude Code's bash tool emits the literal marker `(Bash completed with no output)` when a command has no stdout. The current scrubber mangles it to `( completed with no output)` — ugly and unhelpful. Fix: drop the whole marker cleanly so TTS never says any variant of it. Preserve everything else as-is.
acceptanceCriteria: _scrub_tts_text in src/generator.py strips '(Bash completed with no output)' entirely (result contains neither '(Bash' nor '( completed' nor 'no output)').
The strip happens BEFORE the standalone-bash word-boundary rule so the parens also disappear.
Existing behavior preserved: '{"tool":"bash","args":"x"}' still strips to empty/neutral; '"tool":"bash"' still strips; 'bashful' still passes through.

New unit tests in tests/test_generator.py: (a) '(Bash completed with no output)' → empty/whitespace, (b) 'Фуй! (Bash completed with no output) наступне.' → 'Фуй! наступне.', (c) the existing three scrubber tests still pass.

stories.title: Prefer assistant text summary over raw ToolResult
stories.description: Currently _attempt_query appends BOTH AssistantMessage.TextBlock content AND UserMessage.ToolResultBlock content to stdout_chunks. When Claude provides a summary, appending the raw tool output too results in redundant / duplicative TTS. Change: collect them in separate buckets; when the text bucket is non-empty, return ONLY text. When text is empty, fall back to tool_result. Existing 'on_line' streaming keeps firing per segment regardless.
acceptanceCriteria: _attempt_query returns stdout derived from text_chunks when text_chunks is non-empty; else from tool_result_chunks.
Existing on_line streaming callback still fires for every segment from both block types (observability unchanged).
[SDK DRAIN] log line keeps reporting both text and tool_result counts.
Unit test: scripted transcript with both text and tool_result → returned summary contains only the text content (not the tool result).
Unit test: scripted transcript with only tool_result (no text) → returned summary contains the tool result content.
test_sdk_call_action_captures_tool_result_stdout still passes (its transcript has text blocks, so it just checks text reaches summary).

stories.title: Ukrainian-language action summary
stories.description: The action dispatch prompt currently asks Claude for an English one-liner. heare speaks Ukrainian; English summaries sound wrong through the TTS voice. Ask for the summary in Ukrainian.
acceptanceCriteria: _action_description in src/actions.py still starts with 'Use the {tool} tool: {args}' (contract preserved).
The trailing instruction explicitly asks Claude to reply in Ukrainian ('українською мовою' or equivalent).
Existing unit test test_action_description_includes_summary_instruction asserts the Ukrainian directive is present (updated assertion).
Existing dispatch-contract tests still pass (first line unchanged).
